div.p: Everything you need to know about how your luxury rituals reach your doorstep.

At O&A Beauty, each order is carefully prepared and beautifully packaged by our dedicated team. Orders placed before 1:00 PM (EST) are processed on the same business day. Orders placed after this time, or on weekends/holidays, will be processed the following business day.

Enjoy complimentary standard shipping on all domestic orders over $150. For orders under this amount, a flat rate of $10 applies. Standard delivery typically takes 3 to 5 business days from the date of dispatch.
For those who simply cannot wait, we offer Express Shipping (1-2 business days) for a flat fee of $25. Please note that Express Shipping is not available for P.O. boxes or APO/FPO addresses.

We proudly ship worldwide. International shipping rates are calculated at checkout based on the destination and parcel weight. Delivery times range from 7 to 14 business days. All duties and taxes are prepaid at checkout.
Once your beautifully packaged order leaves our atelier, you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing a tracking link. You can track your parcel's journey at any time.

div.p: Your absolute satisfaction is our highest priority.

At O&A Beauty, we believe in the absolute quality of our products. However, if your ritual does not meet your expectations, we accept returns within 30 days of the delivery date. To be eligible for a full refund, items must be unopened, unused, and in their original pristine packaging.

ol.li: Log into your O&A Beauty account and navigate to the Order History section.
Select the order containing the item you wish to return and click Request Return.
You will instantly receive an email containing a prepaid return shipping label.
Carefully package the items and affix the label before dropping it off at your nearest postal location.

div.p: Once your returned parcel arrives at our facility, our quality team will inspect the items. Refunds are processed within 3 to 5 business days following inspection. The credit will be automatically applied to your original method of payment. Please note that it may take an additional 2-10 business days for your bank to post the refund to your account.

If a product arrives damaged or defective, please accept our sincerest apologies. Contact our conciergerie within 48 hours of delivery, including your order number and photos of the damaged item. We will immediately arrange for a replacement to be expedited to you at no additional cost.
Our dedicated customer care team is here to guide you through the return process.
